title: 第二章 东山小红，你这畜生！
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“规则……如下……”

“每次掷骰，点大者胜，点小者输。”

赌博恶魔发出了沉闷沙哑的声音。透明的躯干内骨头和眼睛一阵摇晃，化作一颗骰子和一只骰盅，吐在了桌面上。

梦野拿起它们，示意打手解开绳子。

打手们照做后，退到外围，枪口却始终对准人群。

毫无疑问，谁有异动，板寸头的下场就是他们的前车之鉴。

在这种氛围下，在场没有一个人敢动。

直到梦野都等得不耐烦了，才开口诱惑道：

“不用那么害怕。不管你们信不信，在赌博恶魔的注视下，这场赌局绝对公平。”

他率先将骰子丢入骰盅，“哗啦”一摇。揭开，点数为四。

“你们并非死路一条。”梦野靠在轮椅上，“等我用你们的身体把这副残躯拼凑完整，说不定会有幸运儿能安然无恙地走出去。外面的高利贷，已经被我一笔勾销掉了。”

“这对你们来说，难道不是一次重生的机会吗？”

沉默了几秒后，终于有人崩溃了。

一个流浪汉扑到桌前，抓起骰盅。

“我赌！我他妈赌！”

他颤抖着抓起骰子，闭着眼睛扔了出去。

骰子停止转动，点数为三。

“呃啊——！！！”

点数落定的那一刻，流浪汉的惨叫响起。他的右臂仿佛在被透明的火焰灼烧，从皮肤再到血肉与骨头，手臂逐渐消失了。

“嗯啊……”

与之形成对比的，是轮椅上的梦野发出了一声舒爽的呻吟。

在所有人惊骇欲绝的注视下，他空荡荡的右侧袖管里，骨头、血管、肌肉像某种诡异的藤蔓一样交织生长。短短几秒钟，一条完好无损的右臂出现在了梦野的肩膀上！

“完美。”梦野陶醉地活动着新生的五指，眼神越发狂热，“我又活过来了！”

“我又可以连载我的新小说了！”

伴随着他的兴奋，异变突生。

前一秒还在地上打滚哀嚎的流浪汉，惨叫声忽然停下了。他的脑袋就像被什么无形之物斩断，竟滚落到了地上！

血液如喷泉般从脖颈喷出，这骇人的一幕刺激到了在场的众人。

“他死了——！！人死了——！！！”

“你骗人！你说只拿走身体的！！”

“我不赌了！我要出去！放我出去！”

Page (1/3)

"The rules...are as follows..."

"Every time you roll a dice, whoever rolls a higher number wins, and whoever rolls a lower number loses."

The gambling demon made a dull, hoarse voice.The bones and eyes in the transparent torso shook, turned into a dice and a dice cup, and spat out on the table.

Meng Ye picked them up and motioned to the thugs to untie the rope.

After the thugs did as they were told, they retreated to the outside, but their guns were always pointed at the crowd.

There is no doubt that whoever makes any changes will learn from their past mistakes.

In this atmosphere, no one dared to move.

It wasn't until Mengye got impatient with waiting that he said seductively:

"Don't be so afraid. Believe it or not, under the eyes of the gambling demon, this bet is absolutely fair."

He took the lead in throwing the dice into the dice cup and shook it with a bang.Revealed, the number is four.

"You are not destined to die." Mengye leaned on the wheelchair. "When I use your bodies to piece this broken body together, maybe there will be a lucky person who can walk out safe and sound. I have written off all the loan sharks outside."

"Isn't this an opportunity for you to be reborn?"

After a few seconds of silence, someone finally collapsed.

A homeless man rushed to the table and grabbed the dice cup.

"I bet! I fucking bet!"

Trembling, he grabbed the dice and threw them with his eyes closed.

The dice stops spinning and the number is three.

"Uhhh-!!!"

The moment the score was settled, the homeless man screamed.His right arm seemed to be burned by transparent flames, from skin to flesh and bone, the arm gradually disappeared.

"Yeah..."

In contrast, Mengye in the wheelchair let out a comfortable groan.

Under everyone's horrified gaze, in his empty right sleeve, bones, blood vessels, and muscles intertwined and grew like some kind of weird vine.In just a few seconds, an intact right arm appeared on Mengye's shoulder!

"Perfect." Mengye moved his new fingers intoxicatedly, his eyes becoming more and more fanatical, "I'm alive again!"

"I can serialize my new novel again!"

Along with his excitement, sudden changes occurred.

The homeless man who was rolling on the ground and wailing a second ago suddenly stopped screaming.His head seemed to have been cut off by something invisible and rolled to the ground!

Blood spurted out from his neck like a fountain, and this horrifying scene excited everyone present.

"He's dead——!! People are dead——!!!"

"You lied! You said you only took away the body!!"

"I won't gamble anymore! I want to get out! Let me out!"
